summary.text: Shelly Crawford is a Democratic member of the Nevada Senate, representing District 1 in Clark County. She was first elected in November 2024, and the legislature lists her as a school principal and member of the Senate Health and Wellness Committee.

paragraphs.text: The Nevada Legislature says Crawford was born in Tucson, Arizona, in 1983 and earned a B.S. in psychology in 2004 and a M.Ed. in curriculum and instruction in 2010, both from the University of Nevada, Las Vegas.
Her page lists an Ed.D. in organizational leadership and policy from William Howard Taft University in 2023.
The page lists her military service in the U.S. Air Force, including as public affairs officer in the Nevada National Guard in 2020 and equal opportunity officer in 2024.
